findings.highlight: Are we not finished for the night
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜はもう休むのではないのですか
findings.governingReading: are you not going to rest for the night
findings.explanation: Saber asks about sleeping; the English changes this into the broader and less concrete idea of being finished for the night.

findings.highlight: I have to go take her some water
findings.evidenceJa: 水を替えないとまずい
findings.governingReading: he needs to replace Sakura’s water
findings.explanation: The English changes replacing the water already left beside Sakura into bringing water to her.

findings.highlight: Close the door
findings.evidenceJa: 襖も閉めて
findings.governingReading: close the sliding fusuma partition
findings.explanation: The room-dividing fusuma becomes an ordinary door, weakening the house’s spatial arrangement and Shirou’s insistence on separation.

findings.highlight: It will do little good if we are not in the same room
findings.evidenceJa: 同室でないのは不都合
findings.governingReading: not being in the same room is inconvenient
findings.explanation: Saber’s practical objection is strengthened into a claim that separate rooms largely defeat the purpose.

findings.highlight: Saber looks discontented
findings.evidenceJa: つーん、と如何にも不満そうな目をするセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber gives him an ostentatiously prim, plainly dissatisfied look
findings.explanation: The English preserves dissatisfaction but removes the pointed comic manner of Saber’s sulk.

findings.highlight: What was I doing for an hour in there
findings.evidenceJa: 一時間も何やってたんだ、俺
findings.governingReading: what was I doing for a whole hour
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “in there,” fixing a location that the source leaves to context.

findings.highlight: There’s only one simple explanation
findings.evidenceJa: 遅れた理由は一つだけだ
findings.governingReading: there is only one reason for the delay
findings.explanation: The English adds that the explanation is simple, pre-judging the awkward care sequence that follows.

findings.highlight: Such simple tasks were really painful and difficult for me
findings.evidenceJa: それだけの作業がとにかく苦しくて、手間取って、とんでも無く困難だった
findings.governingReading: those tasks were painful, took him a long time, and were extraordinarily difficult
findings.explanation: mirror moon calls the care “simple” and omits that Shirou repeatedly lost time performing it.

findings.highlight: I had my eyes closed anyway
findings.evidenceJa: 実際さっきまで目を瞑って作業をしていた
findings.governingReading: he had actually been doing the work with his eyes shut until just now
findings.explanation: The English removes both the work and its duration, weakening the physical comedy of Shirou tending Sakura blindly.

findings.highlight: Everywhere I take a step and everything that touches my hand makes a sticky sound
findings.evidenceJa: 足につくもの、手につくもの全てが、ぬちゃりと音をたてている
findings.governingReading: everything sticking to his feet and hands makes a wet, sticky squelch
findings.explanation: Objects adhering to Shirou’s body become locations he steps and things that touch him; the wet squelching sound is generalized.

findings.highlight: The red sun
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い[ruby text=め]陽
findings.governingReading: the red sun read simultaneously as a red eye
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops the ruby that makes the watching sun an eye.

findings.highlight: Shinto
findings.evidenceJa: 新都
findings.governingReading: the Shinto district or New City
findings.explanation: mirror moon transliterates the district name as the Japanese religion “Shinto,” obscuring Fuyuki geography.

findings.highlight: some kind of evacuation notice and I was the only one who didn’t get it
findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけ気が付かないまま、大がかりな避難勧告でもあった
findings.governingReading: perhaps a large-scale evacuation advisory occurred without only him noticing
findings.explanation: Failure to notice a possible public event becomes failure to receive a notice.

findings.highlight: That thought lets me accept the redness
findings.evidenceJa: この赤色も合点がいく
findings.governingReading: that would make sense of the redness
findings.explanation: Cognitive explanation becomes emotional acceptance.

findings.highlight: She ignores me
findings.evidenceJa: おぉい、遠坂
findings.governingReading: Hey, Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shirou’s spoken call is absent; the next page’s reaction is retained without the utterance that prompts it.

findings.highlight: Her long hair disappears into the school
findings.evidenceJa: 長い髪は学校に入っていく
findings.governingReading: the long hair goes into the school
findings.explanation: The dream’s concrete, impossible focus on the hair entering becomes disappearance.

findings.highlight: There’s nobody in the school either
findings.evidenceJa: 校庭にも人気はない
findings.governingReading: there is no sign of anyone in the schoolyard either
findings.explanation: The empty exterior schoolyard is generalized to the whole school before Shirou enters it.

findings.highlight: it would all fuse into a formless mass
findings.evidenceJa: 正体なく融解する
findings.governingReading: it would melt until it lost all form
findings.explanation: The recurring candy image explicitly melts; mirror moon changes that destruction into fusion.

findings.highlight: It has a charming quality, like two young girls frolicking together
findings.evidenceJa: 幼い少女がふたり、戯れているような微笑ましさ
findings.governingReading: the heartwarming quality of two little girls playing together
findings.explanation: The English turns a tender, childlike emotional impression into generic charm.

findings.highlight: An image rises in my mind of two beautiful sisters, alike as twins
findings.evidenceJa: 双子のようにうり二つの、美しい姉妹の幻影を見る
findings.governingReading: he sees an apparition of beautiful sisters identical as twins
findings.explanation: A perceived apparition in the dream space becomes an internally generated mental image.

findings.highlight: making me doubt the issue of gender
findings.evidenceJa: 性別の問題はうろんに思えた
findings.governingReading: the question of their sex seemed dubious or beside the point
findings.explanation: The English is semantically opaque and does not express why the apparent lovers’ sex ceases to register as an objection.

findings.highlight: In this red scenery, I think they even seem more correct this way
findings.evidenceJa: この赤い風景には、むしろ、彼女たちの方が正しい
findings.governingReading: within this red landscape, the two women themselves seem the more correct presence
findings.explanation: “This way” can make their embrace correct; the source makes the women more fitting than Shirou within the red world.

findings.highlight: Mitsuzuri’s arms are as limp as those of a corpse
findings.evidenceJa: 美綴の腕だけが、だらりと、死人のようにだらしがない
findings.governingReading: only Mitsuzuri’s arm hangs loose and slack like a dead person’s
findings.explanation: mirror moon retains corpse-like limpness but drops the singled-out dangling arm and its unnaturally slack posture.

findings.highlight: She’s feeding on her
findings.evidenceJa: あれは捕食であろう
findings.governingReading: that must be predation
findings.explanation: A dream-bound interpretation is stated as direct fact and given a female actor before the image fully resolves.

findings.highlight: Her life is being stolen away by the second
findings.evidenceJa: 生気が、一秒ごとに奪われている
findings.governingReading: her vitality is being taken away second by second
findings.explanation: Loss of liveliness becomes literal loss of life, sharpening the dream’s apparent event.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is smiling with a lazy look in her eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は温い瞳で笑っている
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka smiles with lukewarm eyes
findings.explanation: The unsettling temperature image in Rin’s gaze becomes ordinary languor.

findings.highlight: it’s as slow as moving through water
findings.evidenceJa: 水中を進むようにもどかしい
findings.governingReading: his attempt is frustrating, like trying to move through water
findings.explanation: The English preserves slowness but removes Shirou’s desperate frustration.

findings.highlight: Mitsuzuri crumples to the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 美綴の膝が砕ける
findings.governingReading: Mitsuzuri’s knees buckle or give way
findings.explanation: A precise bodily failure becomes an invented full-body movement and destination.

findings.highlight: Hahaha… mmm
findings.evidenceJa: ふふふ……ん
findings.governingReading: a low, lingering sensual chuckle
findings.explanation: The loud English laugh breaks the predatory, intimate register.

findings.highlight: The wet sound flows into my ears
findings.evidenceJa: 濡れた音が耳に滴る
findings.governingReading: the wet sound drips into his ears
findings.explanation: The English weakens the liquid dripping image that continues the scene’s bodily texture.

findings.highlight: filled with desire
findings.evidenceJa: 期待に満ちている
findings.governingReading: filled with expectation
findings.explanation: mirror moon sexualizes the voice more explicitly and removes its anticipatory focus on Shirou’s arrival.

findings.highlight: A fly being played with by an orb-weaver
findings.evidenceJa: 女郎蜘蛛に弄ばれる羽虫
findings.governingReading: a winged insect toyed with by a jorougumo, a spider name carrying “woman” and courtesan associations
findings.explanation: The English narrows the prey to a fly and loses the woman-spider lexical mechanism connecting Rin’s allure to predation.

findings.highlight: she confirms that the secret really was a feeding
findings.evidenceJa: 捕食だったのだと頷いた
findings.governingReading: Shirou acknowledges that the secret act was indeed predation
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns Shirou’s realization to Rin and turns his inference into her confirmation.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s sweet scent envelops me, extending her control even to my lungs
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の甘い香りが立ちこめ、肺の中まで支配される
findings.governingReading: Rin’s sweet scent fills the air, and even his lungs come under its sway
findings.explanation: The English makes Rin deliberately extend control, adding agency to an overpowering sensory image.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s limbs are wrapped around me
findings.evidenceJa: 抱きついてくる遠坂の肢体
findings.governingReading: Rin’s body clings to him
findings.explanation: A full-body incoming embrace becomes static wrapping by her limbs.

findings.highlight: drowns out the flickering warnings in my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 点滅する警告をかき消していく
findings.governingReading: drowns out the flashing warning
findings.explanation: The English locates the warning explicitly in Shirou’s mind, resolving a deliberately sensory dream image.

findings.highlight: At the nape of my neck
findings.evidenceJa: 首筋に横から
findings.governingReading: against the side of his neck
findings.explanation: mirror moon moves Rin’s mouth from the side of Shirou’s neck to its back.

findings.highlight: when a spider consumes its prey, it begins by anesthetizing it
findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛は獲物を仕留める時、まず麻酔毒を打つ
findings.governingReading: when a spider finishes off its prey, it first injects anesthetic poison
findings.explanation: The English removes killing, poison, and injection from the predation analogy.

findings.highlight: This anesthesia sends me into an even deeper trance
findings.evidenceJa: この麻酔もまた、恍惚をもたらした
findings.governingReading: this anesthetic likewise brought ecstasy
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes erotic rapture into a deeper altered-consciousness state unsupported by the comparison.

findings.highlight: The sensation of her lips on my skin feels so good, it’s as if I might melt away
findings.evidenceJa: 吸い付いている唇の感触が、歯が、溶ける様に気持ちいい
findings.governingReading: the sensation of the sucking lips—and the teeth—is meltingly pleasurable
findings.explanation: The English deletes the teeth from the compound sensation and turns an adverbial intensity into Shirou possibly melting.

findings.highlight: my body turns steadily into sugar
findings.evidenceJa: 身体が飴細工に変わっていく
findings.governingReading: his body changes into crafted candy
findings.explanation: The recurring candywork image is reduced to undifferentiated sugar.

findings.highlight: It seeps softly into my bones, my muscles,
findings.evidenceJa: 骨を、筋肉を、
findings.governingReading: it softens and macerates his bones, muscles, and skin
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces active dissolution of every tissue layer with harmless liquid seeping.

findings.highlight: unable to even moan
findings.evidenceJa: 呻きしか漏れない
findings.governingReading: nothing but groans can escape
findings.explanation: The English reverses the proposition: the damaged throat permits only groans, rather than preventing groaning.

findings.highlight: the impossible feeling is deceiving my senses
findings.evidenceJa: あり得ない感覚に騙されていく
findings.governingReading: his body below the neck is being deceived by the impossible sensation
findings.explanation: The English reassigns what is deceived from the dissolving body to abstract senses.

findings.highlight: My dizziness causes my vision to blur and duplicate
findings.evidenceJa: 交錯し重複する目眩の絨毯
findings.governingReading: a carpet of intersecting, overlapping dizziness
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents blurred double vision and removes the surreal carpet image.

findings.highlight: While still being eaten
findings.evidenceJa: 食いついたままで
findings.governingReading: while Rin remains bitten or latched onto him
findings.explanation: The grammatical roles reverse: Rin is still feeding on Shirou, but the English makes the implied speaker the one being eaten.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka whispers as she drains me of blood
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は俺を飲み干している
findings.governingReading: Rin is drinking Shirou dry
findings.explanation: The English narrows the object from Shirou’s whole self to blood, weakening the escalating loss of personhood.

findings.highlight: It’s as though there’s a pump inside me
findings.evidenceJa: 中からポンプの様に汲み出されている
findings.governingReading: he is being pumped out from within
findings.explanation: The English retains the pump but omits the extraction it performs.

findings.highlight: my bones are gone
findings.evidenceJa: 骨が抜かれていた
findings.governingReading: his bones have been pulled out
findings.explanation: A violent removal becomes a bare state of absence.

findings.highlight: It’s so full of life, and energy
findings.evidenceJa: 活きが良くって、ぴちぴちして
findings.governingReading: it is lively and fresh, with the bounce of freshly caught prey
findings.explanation: The English states generic vitality and loses Rin’s food-market idiom treating Shirou as fresh prey.

findings.highlight: she persistently sucks from me
findings.evidenceJa: 何処までも吸い取られ続ける
findings.governingReading: he continues to be sucked away without end
findings.explanation: The endless extent of Shirou’s consumption becomes mere persistence.
